FOIL EMBLEM, METALLIC GRADIENT (the standalone-emblem source; needs yet another instrument) — the compass-rose emblem appears ALONE and large, brass-foil-blocked on a dark cover, so it is a gradient of bright metallic hits along the raised edges falling to dark bronze in the recessed shanks rather than one flat colour: a select-by-prompt on the object grabs only the brightest foil and drops the shanks, a raw vectorize shatters the emblem into a dozen banded sub-paths, and the deboss shadow makes background removal grab the cover instead of the mark. The emblem must be selected on the compass rose's own drawn character and its foil gradient flattened to the single Compass Brass #9C8452 ink before it will trace, and the centre ring and triangular point gaps (enclosed counters) cannot be punched by background removal. This is the only high-fidelity rendering of the emblem WITHOUT the wordmark, so it is the source for the standalone-emblem and small-format variants; the old developer's favicon PNG is a fuzzy blur that must not be traced or upscaled.
